plan: My value is $14. I will start with a baseline strategy of bidding slightly below my value, say $13.5. I expect the other bidders to bid similarly, maybe slightly below their values as well. If I bid much lower, I risk losing the auction and making no profit. If I bid much higher, I risk winning but paying too much and making a loss. I will bid $13.5.

My value is $34. I want to maximize my profit. A simple strategy is to bid slightly below my value, say $33.9. If others bid close to their values too, this might win sometimes and give me a good profit. If others bid very low, I might win with a higher bid. I will start with a bid of $33.9. This is my first round, so I have no history to learn from.

I will start with the assumption that the other bidders will bid close to their values. If I bid my value, I will win when I have the highest value, but I will pay close to my value. I will try bidding slightly below my value, say 90% of my value. That would be 0.9 * 33 = 29.7. If the others bid close to their values, I might win sometimes, and when I win, I will pay less than my value.
